decision: Remove the default-off T2 fused-WMMA R28 candidate. It delivers decisive C7 speed and mostly small numerical drift, but one real general_en transition exceeds the absolute production KL ceiling on all seven slots and changes target top-1/acceptance scheduling. Prompt-conditioned exclusion is prohibited; retain the exact grouped-rowtile fallback globally at R28.

candidate.scope: gfx1100 production physical C7/R28 Q4 gate/up K5120/N17408
candidate.strict_fallback: exact grouped Q4 R8 prefix + strict R4 tail for separate gate/up, then separate SiLU

task_performance_gate.protocol: Ten category+heldout prompts, C7/K3/D24, two counterbalanced fresh-process orders.

acceptance.difference: general_en_plan uses seven cycles with candidate accepted counts [3,1,3,3,3,2,1] versus strict six cycles [3,1,3,3,3,3]; accepted total is unchanged but one top-1 transition differs.

strict_teacher_full_logits.capture: Diagnostic BF16 normalized hidden rows with exact slot IDs, positions, schedules, request/transaction IDs, and deterministic candidate repeat; unchanged Q6 root reconstructs full-vocabulary F32 logits offline.

capture_note: The layout active_mask is slot-level, not per packed row; it was renamed slot_active_mask after an initial mistaken pad-row interpretation. The seven outliers are real third-candidate rows whose token IDs are device-overlaid after host layout construction.

validation.final_tree: The R28 policy, environment flag, selector route/test, and REFACTOR entry are removed. Diagnostic packed-verifier capture tooling remains because it closes a genuine evaluator gap and has no effect unless explicitly enabled.
